description: This file provides a function to sanitize HTML content by converting certain inline HTML tags into plain-text or lightweight-markup equivalents suitable for messaging platforms like WhatsApp, Signal, and others. It targets common HTML tags and ensures that remaining tags are stripped, preserving the message content in a plain-text friendly format.

methods.description: Converts common HTML tags in the input text to plain-text or lightweight-markup equivalents and strips any remaining HTML tags, ensuring safe and readable plain-text output for messaging platforms.
